scope: review fixes: 9 P1/P2 defects plus flake stabilization from the external review
host-only completion handlers, post-completion save, derived-move fallback, public battle schema
read-guarded session callbacks, fault isolation, focus pause, idle start gate
candidate discovery without required params, multi-source input merge, fixed-damage scaling

issues.fixed: Completion handlers are host-only: attached PluginHost no longer registers a completion action on the command bus, and settlement only runs on finishing sessions with a frozen result.
After session.complete releases the busy lock, the bridge calls the host changed() again so the settled result is persisted.
When a commit-point recheck fails with continueBase, the prepared derivedMove is dropped and the base move is used.
core.battle.action attachments now allow up to two entries with JSON-string parameters; the engine parses parameters before schema validation.
init/step/view run under the host read guard (runtime.evaluate): dispatch/writes are rejected inside these callbacks.
step/view faults are contained: a step fault fails the session instead of throwing; a view fault returns an empty frame; app frame loop wraps the session branch so scheduling continues.
pauseOnFocusLoss is implemented: pause freezes the clock, resume rebases it, and app visibilitychange pauses/resumes sessions.
core.interaction.start ready now requires an idle host (no battle/story/facility/modal/busy); parent flows use the internal bridge.
Candidate discovery skips required-parameter validation; only prepare/commit validate filled parameters.
BrowserInput records held actions per physical source (key/pointer) and merges them; touch dpad buttons feed the session bridge.
Fixed-damage and plan damage results now pass through the same scaledDamage step as formula damage.

verification.command: npm run test:all repeated x4 after flake fixes
verification.note: Previously the attachment-modifier test was ~5-35% flaky (Tackle 95% accuracy, and the lvl-10 player could faint before acting); the test now pins accuracy and gives the player speed/HP so the modifier resolves.

repairedFailures: Reviewer-observed failure tests/battle-permissions.test.js 'plugin defense decision can block or scale' was RNG-dependent; rewritten deterministically with an engine battle.
tests/battle-attachments.test.js modifier test was flaky: pinned accuracy and survivability.
